detail.body:
# What does this PR do?

Adds Megatron Bridge support for **Reflection AI Beam-1.0-501B-A23B**, including Hugging Face checkpoint conversion, model construction, inference, and H200 pretraining, full SFT, and LoRA PEFT recipes.

The integration registers `BeamForCausalLM` with `AutoBridge` and builds a native Megatron-Core `HybridModel` through `BeamModelConfig` and `BeamModelBuilder`. `BeamModelProvider` is also available for provider-based callers.

# Changelog

- Implement Beam's attention and MoE stack: mixed sliding-window RoPE/full-attention NoPE layers, SSMax query scaling, gated attention output, sandwich normalization, depth-scaled residuals, grouped sigmoid expert routing, FP32 router parameters, and output-logit soft-capping.
- Add bidirectional HF/Megatron configuration and tensor mappings, including attention-gate packing, expert weights and router bias, plus per-output-channel FP8 weight dequantization on import.
- Support builder-backed model families when merging and exporting LoRA adapters in `AutoBridge`. Add an overridable HF adapter `target_modules` hook so exported adapters select the intended modules.
- Add BF16 H200 library recipes for pretraining and full SFT on 128 GPUs, and LoRA PEFT on 16 GPUs, with documented long-context SFT settings.
- Add `--max-gpu-memory-gib` to the HF inference verifier to reserve loading headroom for large models.
- Add tests for configuration validation, modeling operations, tensor mapping round trips, FP8 import, adapter export, recipes, and inference-verifier options.
- Add the [model guide](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/8a0ebe5c7306f8349a60c2efbaea23f05612af94/examples/models/beam/README.md) and [verification card](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/8a0ebe5c7306f8349a60c2efbaea23f05612af94/examples/model_verification_cards/beam/card.yaml), and regenerate the verification catalog, model pages, and documentation navigation.

# Validation and scope

The verification card records CPU/GPU BF16 checkpoint round trips, HF/Megatron forward-pass comparison, deterministic Megatron inference, pretraining, SFT, long-context SFT, PEFT, checkpoint resume, and deterministic HF inference after SFT export. Its timing and throughput metrics are functional verification observations; this PR does not provide a canonical optimized pretraining benchmark result.

On the final PR head, core unit-test shards, diffusion unit tests, the import check, lint, copyright, documentation, and link checks passed. The [DeepSeek recipe L0 job](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/actions/runs/38897637873/job/117011109195) failed, so the aggregate NeMo CI result was not fully green.

The documented inference path uses legacy full-prefix generation; KV-cache inference is not verified. CPU conversion still requires one runtime GPU for Transformer Engine construction. HF loading requires a Beam-enabled Transformers build. The supplied training recipes are BF16; FP8 import support does not imply FP8 training recipes.

# GitHub Actions CI

See the [CI section](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#-running-github-ci) in the Contributing doc for how to trigger the CI. A Nvidia developer will need to approve and trigger the CI for external contributors.

# Before your PR is "Ready for review"

**Pre checks**:

- [x] Make sure you read and followed [Contributor guidelines](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [x] Did you write any new necessary tests?
- [x] Did you add or update any necessary documentation?
- [ ] Does the PR affect components that are optional to install? (Ex: Numba, Pynini, Apex etc)
  - [ ] Reviewer: Does the PR have correct import guards for all optional libraries?

+# Beam
+
+Megatron Bridge supports checkpoint conversion, inference, pretraining, full SFT and LoRA PEFT for Beam, a 52-layer
+sparse mixture-of-experts language model with about 501B parameters. Three dense layers are followed by 49 MoE layers
+with 256 routed experts each (top-8). Attention alternates five sliding-window layers (window 512, RoPE) with one
+full-attention NoPE layer, and the last layer uses full attention. See the
+[Beam verification card](../../model_verification_cards/beam/card.yaml) for the exact commands, revisions, metrics and
+current verification status.
+
+## Supported Variants
+
+| Variant | Hugging Face model | Published weight format |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| Beam-1.0-501B-A23B | `reflection/Beam-1.0-501B-A23B` | BF16 |
+
+The commands below pin revision `3ea13c81833d9a523ed4bdc4152a33edd16bbd30`, the revision the verification card records.
+
+## Modeling
+
+Beam uses the builder-backed API. `BeamBridge` translates the Hugging Face configuration directly into
+`BeamModelConfig`, and `BeamModelBuilder` constructs a native Megatron-Core `HybridModel`: each Beam layer is an
+attention/MLP (or attention/MoE) pair in the hybrid layer pattern. `BeamModelProvider` remains only as a compatibility
+path for provider-based callers.
+
+The Beam stack spec preserves the published decoder math: GQA (48 query heads, 8 KV heads) with Q/K RMSNorm, a
+full-width sigmoid attention output gate with a per-head bias, sandwich RMSNorms after attention and after the MLP,
+depth-scaled residual connections, SSMax query scaling on the NoPE layers, grouped sigmoid routing (8 groups, top-4
+groups, normalized top-8 weights, routed scaling 2.5) with an expert bias and FP32 router parameters, and a tanh
+soft cap of 30 on the output logits. The bridge maps the expert-bias update rate to zero, so fine-tuning and the
+bounded pretraining recipe keep the published router bias fixed and add no auxiliary load-balancing loss.
+
+## Builder-backed configuration
+
+```python
+from megatron.bridge import AutoBridge
+
+bridge = AutoBridge.from_hf_pretrained(
+    "reflection/Beam-1.0-501B-A23B", revision="3ea13c81833d9a523ed4bdc4152a33edd16bbd30"  # pragma: allowlist secret
+)
+model_config = bridge.get_model_config()
+
+# Apply deployment-specific parallelism before construction.
+model_config.tensor_model_parallel_size = 2
+model_config.expert_model_parallel_size = 16
+models = bridge.get_model(model_config)
+```
+
+## Runtime Requirements
+
+Beam runs on the repository's default Megatron-Core pin. The bridge adds Beam's SSMax scaling, attention-gate bias,
+sandwich norms, depth-scaled residuals and FP32 router parameters on top of an unmodified Megatron-Core
+`HybridModel`, so no Megatron-LM branch switch is needed. Loading the Hugging Face checkpoint needs a Transformers
+build that includes Beam (see Known Limitations). The verification runs used the `nvcr.io/nvidia/pytorch:26.08-py3` base container; see the
+[repository installation instructions](../../../README.md#-installation).
+
+The Slurm launchers require an account, partition, and container image. Set them before running any
+`--executor slurm` conversion or `train.sh` command:
+
+```bash
+export SLURM_ACCOUNT=your-account
+export SLURM_PARTITION=your-partition
+export CONTAINER_IMAGE=your-container-image
+```
+
+The conversion and Megatron inference commands below follow the verification card's commands with shorter paths; the
+card's commands ran on H200 (CPU conversion on a B300 host) through the launchers' Python entry points. The training commands are shortened from the
+card's commands, which add the pinned dataset revision, seeds, NaN checks and logging options.
+
+## Conversion
+
+The BF16 checkpoint is about 1 TB. GPU import and export on H200 use two nodes at EP16, which places about 69 GiB of
+weights on each GPU; EP8 on one node would need about 127 GiB per GPU and leaves too little headroom.
+
+```bash
+# HF -> Megatron (2 x 8 H200)
+./scripts/conversion/convert.sh import --executor slurm --device gpu --nodes 2 --gpus-per-node 8 \
+  --hf-model reflection/Beam-1.0-501B-A23B \
+  --hf-revision 3ea13c81833d9a523ed4bdc4152a33edd16bbd30 \
+  --megatron-path work/models/beam --torch-dtype bfloat16 \
+  --tp 1 --pp 1 --ep 16 --etp 1 --distributed-timeout-minutes 110 --low-memory-save
+
+# Megatron -> HF (2 x 8 H200)
+./scripts/conversion/convert.sh export --executor slurm --device gpu --nodes 2 --gpus-per-node 8 \
+  --hf-model reflection/Beam-1.0-501B-A23B \
+  --hf-revision 3ea13c81833d9a523ed4bdc4152a33edd16bbd30 \
+  --megatron-path work/models/beam/iter_0000000 \
+  --hf-path work/models/beam-hf-export --torch-dtype bfloat16 \
+  --tp 1 --pp 1 --ep 16 --etp 1 --distributed-timeout-minutes 110 \
+  --distributed-save --save-every-n-ranks 1 --no-progress
+```
+
+The GPU round trip reproduces all 38,366 source tensors exactly; `config.json` differs only in `transformers_version`.
+
+CPU import and export run in a single process on a host with well over 1 TB of memory and need one runtime GPU
+(`--gpus-per-node 1`): Beam's attention layers are Transformer Engine modules, and Transformer Engine refuses to
+construct them without CUDA even though the weights stay on CPU. The GPU holds only the CUDA context.
+
+```bash
+./scripts/conversion/convert.sh import --executor slurm --device cpu --nodes 1 --gpus-per-node 1 \
+  --hf-model reflection/Beam-1.0-501B-A23B \
+  --hf-revision 3ea13c81833d9a523ed4bdc4152a33edd16bbd30 \
+  --megatron-path work/models/beam-cpu --torch-dtype bfloat16
+
+./scripts/conversion/convert.sh export --executor slurm --device cpu --nodes 1 --gpus-per-node 1 \
+  --hf-model reflection/Beam-1.0-501B-A23B \
+  --hf-revision 3ea13c81833d9a523ed4bdc4152a33edd16bbd30 \
+  --megatron-path work/models/beam-cpu/iter_0000000 \
+  --hf-path work/models/beam-cpu-hf-export --torch-dtype bfloat16
+```
+
+## Inference
+
+Megatron generation uses the non-cached legacy full-prefix path on 2 x 8 H200:
+
+```bash
+./scripts/inference/infer.sh --nodes 2 --gpus-per-node 8 --task legacy-full-prefix-generation \
+  --hf_model_path reflection/Beam-1.0-501B-A23B \
+  --hf-revision 3ea13c81833d9a523ed4bdc4152a33edd16bbd30 \
+  --megatron_model_path work/models/beam/iter_0000000 \
+  --tp 1 --pp 1 --ep 16 --etp 1 \
+  --prompt 'Explain why the sky appears blue in one sentence.' \
+  --max_new_tokens 32 --apply-chat-template --legacy-full-prefix
+```
+
+Greedy generation is deterministic across runs. Beam's chat template opens each response in the analysis channel,
+so short token budgets end before the final channel.
+
+To compare the imported checkpoint with Hugging Face, use `--task model-comparison` with reference logits from a BF16
+Hugging Face forward of the same revision (`--hf-logits-path`). On the prompt "The capital of France is the city of"
+both predict " Paris" with cosine similarity 0.9997.
+
+For Hugging Face inference on a single 8 x H200 node, cap each GPU at 110 GiB so Transformers offloads the remaining
+layers to CPU. Uncapped `--device-map auto` placement runs out of memory while it stacks the per-expert weights, and
+a 125 GiB cap leaves only about 1.5 GiB of headroom when the loader stacks two layers at once:
+
+```bash
+./scripts/inference/infer.sh --task hf-inference --nodes 1 --gpus-per-node 8 \
+  --hf-model work/models/beam-hf-export \
+  --prompt 'Write one concise sentence explaining why deterministic tests matter:' \
+  --max-new-tokens 16 --chat-template --device-map auto --max-gpu-memory-gib 110
+```
+
+## Recipes
+
+Hardware-qualified library recipes are defined under [`recipes/beam`](../../../src/megatron/bridge/recipes/beam):
+
+| Recipe | Layout | Purpose |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| `beam_pretrain_128gpu_h200_bf16_config` | 16 nodes, TP2 / EP128, SP | Bounded pretraining; BF16 gradients and Adam moments with FP32 master weights |
+| `beam_sft_128gpu_h200_bf16_config` | 16 nodes, TP8 / PP2 / EP64, SP | Full SFT on 8K packed sequences, GBS 8, DP 8 |
+| `beam_peft_16gpu_h200_bf16_config` | 2 nodes, TP2 / EP16, SP | LoRA (rank 8, alpha 16) on `linear_qkv` and `linear_proj`, 8K packed sequences, GBS 8 |
+
+All three recipes resolve the model and tokenizer from the pinned Hub revision; pass `hf_path` to use a local
+checkpoint instead. They use the all-to-all MoE dispatcher and full recompute. Use expert parallelism first: the
+experts hold about 493B of the 501B parameters, so pipeline parallelism does not lower the memory floor. All-to-all
+context parallelism needs the KV heads per tensor-parallel rank to be divisible by the context-parallel size, so CP8
+runs at TP1. With context parallelism, SFT switches to per-token loss normalization, which is why the 8K SFT
+layout reaches DP8 without it.
+
+All training commands below start from the imported Megatron checkpoint, keep Beam's routing natural
+(`model.transformer.moe_router_force_load_balancing=false`), and raise the collective timeout because rank 0 packs
+the dataset offline while the other ranks wait.
+
+### Supervised Fine-Tuning
+
+```bash
+./scripts/training/train.sh --nodes 16 --gpus-per-node 8 \
+  --recipe beam_sft_128gpu_h200_bf16_config --mode sft --dataset tulu3 \
+  --pretrained_checkpoint work/models/beam/iter_0000000 \
+  --max_steps 100 --seq_length 8192 --lr 5e-6 --min_lr 0 --warmup_iters 10 \
+  'dataset.hf_dataset.split="train[:10000]"' \
+  dataset.enable_offline_packing=true dataset.hf_output_root=work/data/beam-tulu3-8k \
+  +dataset.offline_packing_specs.pad_seq_to_mult=8 scheduler.lr_decay_iters=100 \
+  model.transformer.moe_router_force_load_balancing=false \
+  checkpoint.save_optim=false checkpoint.save_rng=false \
+  --save_dir work/results/beam-sft --save_interval 100 \
+  dist.distributed_timeout_minutes=120 \
+  '++tokenizer.hf_tokenizer_kwargs.revision="3ea13c81833d9a523ed4bdc4152a33edd16bbd30"'  # pragma: allowlist secret
+```
+
+For 64K sequences, keep the SFT recipe and switch to all-to-all context parallelism of 8 at TP1:
+`--seq_length 65536 model.transformer.context_parallel_size=8 model.transformer.tensor_model_parallel_size=1
+model.transformer.sequence_parallel=false model.transformer.pipeline_model_parallel_size=2
+model.transformer.expert_model_parallel_size=64 +dataset.offline_packing_specs.pad_seq_to_mult=16`.
+
+### Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning
+
+```bash
+./scripts/training/train.sh --nodes 2 --gpus-per-node 8 \
+  --recipe beam_peft_16gpu_h200_bf16_config --mode lora --dataset tulu3 \
+  --pretrained_checkpoint work/models/beam/iter_0000000 \
+  --max_steps 100 --seq_length 8192 --lr 1e-4 --min_lr 0 --warmup_iters 10 \
+  'dataset.hf_dataset.split="train[:10000]"' \
+  dataset.enable_offline_packing=true dataset.hf_output_root=work/data/beam-tulu3-8k-pad2 \
+  +dataset.offline_packing_specs.pad_seq_to_mult=2 scheduler.lr_decay_iters=100 \
+  model.transformer.moe_router_force_load_balancing=false \
+  --save_dir work/results/beam-peft --save_interval 100 \
+  '++tokenizer.hf_tokenizer_kwargs.revision="3ea13c81833d9a523ed4bdc4152a33edd16bbd30"'  # pragma: allowlist secret
+```
+
+The adapter checkpoint holds 208 LoRA matrices (52 attention layers x 2 projections x 2 matrices).
+
+### Pretraining
+
+```bash
+./scripts/training/train.sh --nodes 16 --gpus-per-node 8 \
+  --recipe beam_pretrain_128gpu_h200_bf16_config --mode pretrain \
+  --dataset megatron-indexed --seq_length 4096 --max_steps 100 --warmup_iters 40 \
+  'dataset.blend=[["work/data/wikitext103/wikitext103_beam_text_document"],null]' \
+  scheduler.lr_decay_iters=100 model.transformer.moe_router_force_load_balancing=false \
+  --pretrained_checkpoint work/models/beam/iter_0000000 checkpoint.load=null \
+  --save_dir work/results/beam-pretrain --save_interval 50 \
+  dist.distributed_timeout_minutes=120
+```
+
+The dataset must be tokenized with Beam's tokenizer into Megatron's indexed format. To resume, pass
+`--load_dir work/results/beam-pretrain` with `checkpoint.ckpt_step=<step>` and a new `--save_dir`.
+
+## Storage
+
+| Artifact | Approximate size |
+| --- | --- |
+| Hugging Face checkpoint | 1.0 TB |
+| Imported BF16 Megatron checkpoint | 934 GiB |
+| Each exported BF16 HF checkpoint | 1.0 TB |
+| Each model-only SFT checkpoint (`checkpoint.save_optim=false`) | 1.0 TB |
+| Each full-state pretraining checkpoint (weights, FP32 master weights, optimizer state) | about 5 TB |
+| LoRA adapter checkpoint | 182 MB |
+
+## Known Limitations
+
+- The launcher's distributed CPU export requests no GPU resources and therefore fails for Beam with
+  "TransformerEngine needs CUDA". Use the single-process CPU commands above with one runtime GPU.
+- Megatron KV-cache inference is not verified; use the legacy full-prefix generation path.
+- Only BF16 recipes are provided; FP8 and Blackwell recipes are not part of this release.
+- Beam is not in a Transformers release yet, so loading the Hugging Face checkpoint currently needs a Transformers
+  nightly build.

+def _capped_max_memory(torch: Any, max_gpu_memory_gib: float) -> dict[int | str, int]:
+    """Cap every visible GPU and let the remaining modules use CPU memory.
+
+    The CPU budget is 90% of the available host memory, the share Transformers uses when no budget is given.
+    """
+    import psutil
+
+    gpu_budget = int(max_gpu_memory_gib * 1024**3)
+    max_memory: dict[int | str, int] = {index: gpu_budget for index in range(torch.cuda.device_count())}
+    max_memory["cpu"] = int(psutil.virtual_memory().available * 0.9)
+    return max_memory
+

+"""Beam config and checkpoint conversion.
+
+Beam uses grouped sigmoid routing, sandwich norms, depth-scaled residuals,
+full-width attention gates, SSMax on NoPE layers, and fp32 logit soft-capping.
+Router parameters remain fp32; export with ``weight_dtype=None`` preserves them.
+The expert-bias update rate defaults to zero for checkpoint fine-tuning. The modules
+Megatron-Core lacks for these features live in :mod:`.modeling_beam`.
+
+The Megatron model is a ``HybridModel`` with two hybrid layers per Beam layer ``i``:
+attention at ``decoder.layers.{2i}`` and the dense MLP or MoE at ``decoder.layers.{2i+1}``.
+"""
+
+import warnings
+from typing import Any, Collection, Iterable, Mapping
+
+import torch
+from megatron.core.models.hybrid.hybrid_layer_allocation import Symbols
+from megatron.core.models.hybrid.hybrid_model import HybridModel
+
+from megatron.bridge.models.beam.beam_config import BeamModelConfig
+from megatron.bridge.models.beam.beam_mappings import BeamQKVGateMapping, split_qkv_gate_weights
+from megatron.bridge.models.beam.beam_provider import BeamModelProvider
+from megatron.bridge.models.conversion import quantization_utils
+from megatron.bridge.models.conversion.mapping_registry import MegatronMappingRegistry
+from megatron.bridge.models.conversion.model_bridge import MegatronModelBridge
+from megatron.bridge.models.conversion.param_mapping import AutoMapping, GatedMLPMapping
+from megatron.bridge.models.conversion.peft_bridge import _split_hf_lora_weight_name
+
+
+LAYER_TYPES = ("sliding_attention", "full_attention")
+MLP_LAYER_TYPES = ("dense", "sparse")
+
+# The soft-capped output layer uses column-parallel checkpoint sharding.
+AutoMapping.register_module_type("BeamOutputLayer", "column")
+# The per-head output-gate bias is sharded across TP ranks together with the heads.
+AutoMapping.register_module_type("AttentionOutputGateBias", "column")
+# The fp32 router subclass is replicated like Megatron-Core's TopKRouter.
+AutoMapping.register_module_type("BeamTopKRouter", "replicated")
+
+
+def _per_layer_types(hf_config, name: str, allowed: Collection[str]) -> list[str]:
+    """Read a per-layer type list (``layer_types`` / ``mlp_layer_types``) and validate it."""
+    values = getattr(hf_config, name, None)
+    if not values:
+        raise ValueError(f"Beam requires {name!r} with one entry per layer.")
+    values = list(values)
+    num_layers = hf_config.num_hidden_layers
+    if len(values) != num_layers:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} has {len(values)} entries for {num_layers} layers.")
+    unknown = sorted(set(values) - set(allowed))
+    if unknown:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} contains {unknown}; expected only {list(allowed)}.")
+    return values
+
+
+def _moe_layer_pattern(hf_config) -> list[int]:
+    """Return 1 for sparse layers and 0 for dense layers."""
+    return [int(t == "sparse") for t in _per_layer_types(hf_config, "mlp_layer_types", MLP_LAYER_TYPES)]
+
+
+def _rope_settings(hf_config) -> tuple[list[int] | None, float | None]:
+    """``(no_rope_freq, rotary_base)`` from ``rope_parameters`` keyed by layer type.
+
+    HF ``BeamModel`` computes RoPE for a layer type whose ``rope_parameters`` entry is a
+    dict and runs NoPE + SSMax for a layer type whose entry is ``None``. Megatron marks
+    NoPE per layer (``no_rope_freq[i]`` truthy = skip RoPE) and has a single ``rotary_base``,
+    so every RoPE layer type must use plain RoPE with the same theta.
+
+    ``no_rope_freq`` is ``None`` when every layer uses RoPE (core's default); ``rotary_base``
+    is ``None`` when no layer does.
+    """
+    layer_types = _per_layer_types(hf_config, "layer_types", LAYER_TYPES)
+    rope_parameters = getattr(hf_config, "rope_parameters", None)
+    if not isinstance(rope_parameters, dict) or not set(layer_types) <= set(rope_parameters):
+        raise ValueError(
+            "Beam configs define rope_parameters keyed by layer type, e.g. "
+            "{'sliding_attention': {'rope_type': 'default', 'rope_theta': 10000.0}, 'full_attention': None}; "
+            f"got {rope_parameters!r} for layer types {sorted(set(layer_types))}."
+        )
+    thetas: set[float] = set()
+    for layer_type in sorted(set(layer_types)):
+        params = rope_parameters[layer_type]
+        if params is None:
+            continue
+        rope_type = params.get("rope_type", "default")
+        if rope_type != "default":
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"rope_parameters[{layer_type!r}] uses rope_type={rope_type!r}; only plain RoPE is supported."
+            )
+        if params.get("rope_theta") is None:
+            raise ValueError(f"rope_parameters[{layer_type!r}] has no rope_theta.")
+        thetas.add(float(params["rope_theta"]))
+    if len(thetas) > 1:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"Megatron has a single rotary_base, but the layer types use different rope_theta: {sorted(thetas)}."
+        )
+    no_rope_freq = [1 if rope_parameters[t] is None else 0 for t in layer_types]
+    return (no_rope_freq if any(no_rope_freq) else None), (thetas.pop() if thetas else None)
+
+
+def _on_attention_layers(flags: list[int]) -> list[int]:
+    """Spread per-Beam-layer flags over the hybrid layers: set on attention (even) layers, 0 on MLP layers."""
+    return [value for flag in flags for value in (flag, 0)]
+
+
+def _beam_settings(hf_config) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Megatron config settings for a ``BeamConfig``."""
+    layer_types = _per_layer_types(hf_config, "layer_types", LAYER_TYPES)
+    moe_layer_freq = _moe_layer_pattern(hf_config)
+    no_rope_freq, rotary_base = _rope_settings(hf_config)
+
+    if getattr(hf_config, "attention_bias", False):
+        raise ValueError(
+            "attention_bias=True is not supported: the bridge fuses q/k/v/gate_proj into a bias-free linear_qkv "
+            "(BeamQKVGateMapping handles weights only) and Beam checkpoints ship attention_bias=False."
+        )
+
+    num_experts = getattr(hf_config, "num_experts", None) or 0
+    if any(moe_layer_freq) and num_experts <= 0:
+        raise ValueError("mlp_layer_types has 'sparse' layers but num_experts is not set.")
+    if not getattr(hf_config, "norm_topk_prob", True):
+        raise ValueError(
+            "Beam's grouped sigmoid router is mapped onto moe_router_pre_softmax=False, which always "
+            "renormalises the selected experts; norm_topk_prob=False has no megatron-core equivalent."
+        )
+    n_group = getattr(hf_config, "n_group", None)
+    topk_group = getattr(hf_config, "topk_group", None)
+    if n_group and topk_group and hf_config.num_experts_per_tok // topk_group != 2:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "Beam scores a routing group by the sum of its top-2 experts (hard-coded in "
+            "BeamTopKRouter); megatron-core uses the sum of its top-(num_experts_per_tok // topk_group) "
+            f"experts. The routers only agree when that ratio is 2, got {hf_config.num_experts_per_tok // topk_group}."
+        )
+
+    settings: dict[str, Any] = dict(
+        num_layers=2 * len(layer_types),
+        # HybridModel-aware paths: SP scatter of the packed padding mask, output-layer init depth.
+        is_hybrid_model=True,
+        hybrid_layer_pattern="".join(
+            f"{Symbols.ATTENTION}{Symbols.MOE if moe else Symbols.MLP}" for moe in moe_layer_freq
+        ),
+        normalization="RMSNorm",
+        gated_linear_unit=True,
+        add_bias_linear=False,
+        hidden_dropout=0.0,
+        qk_layernorm=True,  # q_norm / k_norm over head_dim
+        attention_softmax_in_fp32=True,
+        autocast_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+        share_embeddings_and_output_weights=bool(getattr(hf_config, "tie_word_embeddings", False)),
+        position_embedding_type="rope",
+        rotary_percent=1.0,
+        attention_output_gate=True,
+        add_qkv_bias=False,
+        attention_output_gate_bias=True,
+        post_self_attn_layernorm=True,
+        post_mlp_layernorm=True,
+        depth_scaled_residual=True,
+        final_logit_softcapping=getattr(hf_config, "final_logit_softcapping", None),
+    )
+    if rotary_base is not None:
+        # The generic rope_theta_from_hf() does not understand rope_parameters keyed by layer
+        # type and silently falls back to default_theta, so set the base explicitly.
+        settings["rotary_base"] = rotary_base
+
+    if any(moe_layer_freq):
+        settings.update(
+            num_moe_experts=num_experts,
+            moe_ffn_hidden_size=hf_config.moe_intermediate_size,
+            moe_router_topk=hf_config.num_experts_per_tok,
+            moe_router_score_function="sigmoid",
+            moe_router_enable_expert_bias=True,
+            moe_router_pre_softmax=False,  # norm_topk_prob=True, enforced above
+            moe_router_dtype="fp32",
+            moe_router_fp32_params=True,
+            moe_grouped_gemm=True,
+            moe_token_dispatcher_type="alltoall",
+            moe_permute_fusion=True,
+            moe_router_load_balancing_type="none",
+            moe_aux_loss_coeff=0.0,
+            # Checkpoint fine-tuning keeps the expert bias fixed.
+            moe_router_bias_update_rate=0.0,
+        )
+        if n_group:
+            settings["moe_router_num_groups"] = n_group
+        if topk_group:
+            settings["moe_router_group_topk"] = topk_group
+        if getattr(hf_config, "routed_scaling_factor", None) is not None:
+            settings["moe_router_topk_scaling_factor"] = float(hf_config.routed_scaling_factor)
+    else:
+        # Dense models ignore the HF config's MoE defaults.
+        settings.update(
+            num_moe_experts=None,
+            moe_ffn_hidden_size=None,
+            moe_router_num_groups=None,
+            moe_router_group_topk=None,
+            moe_router_topk_scaling_factor=None,
+        )
+
+    # A truthy window_attn_skip_freq entry enables window attention on that layer.
+    sliding = [1 if t == "sliding_attention" else 0 for t in layer_types]
+    if any(sliding):
+        sliding_window = getattr(hf_config, "sliding_window", None)
+        if not sliding_window:
+            raise ValueError("layer_types has 'sliding_attention' layers but sliding_window is not set.")
+        # HF counts the current token in the window, Megatron does not
+        settings["window_size"] = (sliding_window - 1, 0)
+        settings["window_attn_skip_freq"] = _on_attention_layers(sliding)
+
+    if no_rope_freq is not None:
+        settings["no_rope_freq"] = _on_attention_layers(no_rope_freq)
+        settings["ssmax"] = True
+    return settings
+
+
+#: MoE keys an all-dense export leaves to ``BeamConfig``'s defaults (see ``megatron_to_hf_config``).
+_DENSE_EXPORT_DROPS = (
+    "num_experts",
+    "moe_intermediate_size",
+    "num_experts_per_tok",
+    "norm_topk_prob",
+    "n_group",
+    "topk_group",
+    "routed_scaling_factor",
+)
+
+
+def _as_layer_list(value, num_layers: int, *, int_rule) -> list[int]:
+    """Expand a Megatron ``int | list`` per-layer knob into a list of length ``num_layers``."""
+    if isinstance(value, int):
+        return [1 if int_rule(i, value) else 0 for i in range(num_layers)]
+    return [1 if v else 0 for v in value]
+
+
+@MegatronModelBridge.register_bridge(
+    source="BeamForCausalLM",
+    target=HybridModel,
+    provider=BeamModelProvider,
+    model_type="beam",
+)
+class BeamBridge(MegatronModelBridge):
+    """Bridge between HuggingFace ``BeamForCausalLM`` and Megatron-Core ``HybridModel``.
+
+    Example:
+        >>> from megatron.bridge import AutoBridge
+        >>> bridge = AutoBridge.from_hf_pretrained("<beam-checkpoint>")
+        >>> model_config = bridge.get_model_config()
+        >>> model = bridge.get_model(model_config)
+
+    The builder path is preferred; ``to_megatron_provider()`` remains available for legacy consumers.
+    """
+
+    MODEL_CONFIG_CLASS = BeamModelConfig
+    USE_MODEL_CONFIG_FOR_CONVERSION = True
+
+    def _adapter_target_modules(self, adapter_weight_names: Iterable[str]) -> list[str]:
+        """Use exact paths: Beam's attention and MLP both contain gate_proj.
+
+        This also matters for MLP-only adapters: a bare gate_proj would silently
+        attach an unexported adapter to every attention gate and other layers.
+        """
+        return sorted(
+            {_split_hf_lora_weight_name(name)[0].removeprefix("base_model.model.") for name in adapter_weight_names}
+        )
+
+    def _is_fused_qkv(self, hf_weight_names: Iterable[str]) -> bool:
+        """Recognize Beam's four attention projections, including its independent gate."""
+        names = list(hf_weight_names)
+        expected = {"q_proj", "k_proj", "v_proj", "gate_proj"}
+        return (
+            len(names) == 4
+            and {name.rsplit(".", 2)[-2] for name in names if name.endswith(".weight")} == expected
+            and all(".self_attn." in name for name in names)
+        )
+
+    def _infer_qkv_projection_from_name(self, hf_name: str) -> str | None:
+        """Keep attention gate_proj distinct from the MLP gate."""
+        if hf_name.endswith(".self_attn.gate_proj.weight"):
+            return "gate_proj"
+        return super()._infer_qkv_projection_from_name(hf_name)
+
+    def _split_qkv_linear_out_weight(
+        self, megatron_model: HybridModel | list[HybridModel], linear_out_weight: torch.Tensor
+    ) -> dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
+        """Split fused LoRA B along the same Q/gate/K/V rows as the base weight.
+
+        The trailing dimension is the adapter rank, not the model hidden size.
+        The export and merged-weight paths both use this hook; LoRA A is shared.
+        """
+        model = megatron_model[0] if isinstance(megatron_model, list) else megatron_model
+        q, k, v, gate = split_qkv_gate_weights(model.config, linear_out_weight)
+        return {"q_proj": q, "k_proj": k, "v_proj": v, "gate_proj": gate}
+
+    # FP8_DYNAMIC stores one symmetric weight scale per output channel, shaped [out, 1].
+    FP8_WEIGHT_SCALE_SUFFIX = "_scale"
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def get_hf_import_param_names(
+        hf_param: str | dict[str, str],
+        available_hf_param_names: set[str] | None = None,
+    ) -> tuple[str, ...]:
+        """Also declare the ``weight_scale`` companions so incremental imports wait for them."""
+        names = MegatronModelBridge.get_hf_import_param_names(hf_param, available_hf_param_names)
+        if available_hf_param_names is None:
+            return names
+        scales = [
+            f"{name}{BeamBridge.FP8_WEIGHT_SCALE_SUFFIX}"
+            for name in names
+            if name.endswith(".weight") and f"{name}{BeamBridge.FP8_WEIGHT_SCALE_SUFFIX}" in available_hf_param_names
+        ]
+        return tuple(dict.fromkeys((*names, *scales)))
+
+    def maybe_modify_loaded_hf_weight(
+        self,
+        hf_param: str | dict[str, str],
+        hf_state_dict: Mapping[str, torch.Tensor],
+    ) -> torch.Tensor | dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
+        """Dequantize per-output-channel FP8 weights on the fly; bf16 tensors pass through."""
+        hf_weights = super().maybe_modify_loaded_hf_weight(hf_param, hf_state_dict)
+        if isinstance(hf_weights, dict):
+            return {
+                key: self._maybe_dequantize_fp8(tensor, hf_param[key], hf_state_dict)
+                for key, tensor in hf_weights.items()
+            }
+        return self._maybe_dequantize_fp8(hf_weights, hf_param, hf_state_dict)
+
+    @classmethod
+    def _maybe_dequantize_fp8(
+        cls,
+        weight: torch.Tensor,
+        param_name: str,
+        hf_state_dict: Mapping[str, torch.Tensor],
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """``fp8_weight * weight_scale`` in fp32 (one rounding when the mapping casts to the param dtype)."""
+        if not quantization_utils.is_fp8_tensor(weight):
+            return weight
+        scale_key = f"{param_name}{cls.FP8_WEIGHT_SCALE_SUFFIX}"
+        scale = hf_state_dict.get(scale_key)
+        if scale is None:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"{param_name} is stored as {weight.dtype} but {scale_key} is missing. Beam FP8 checkpoints must "
+                "carry compressed-tensors FP8_DYNAMIC weight_scale tensors; a bare cast would silently corrupt "
+                "the weights."
+            )
+        if weight.ndim != 2 or tuple(scale.shape) != (weight.shape[0], 1):
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"{scale_key} has shape {tuple(scale.shape)} for a weight of shape {tuple(weight.shape)}; expected a "
+                "per-output-channel scale of shape [out_features, 1] (FP8_DYNAMIC). Block or per-tensor FP8 "
+                "layouts are not supported by the Beam bridge."
+            )
+        return quantization_utils.maybe_dequantize_fp8(weight, scale, dtype=torch.float32)
+
+    def hf_config_to_model_config_kwargs(self, hf_config) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        """Flat kwargs for :class:`BeamModelConfig` (builder-backed path)."""
+        config_kwargs = super().hf_config_to_model_config_kwargs(hf_config)
+        config_kwargs.update(_beam_settings(hf_config))
+        return config_kwargs
+
+    @classmethod
+    def megatron_to_hf_config(cls, provider) -> dict:
+        """Invert the config mapping so an exported checkpoint loads as ``BeamForCausalLM``.
+
+        ``provider`` is a :class:`BeamModelConfig`, which proxies attribute access to its
+        nested transformer config. Its per-layer settings count hybrid layers; Beam layer
+        ``i`` reads them from hybrid layers ``2i`` (attention) and ``2i + 1`` (MLP).
+        """
+        hf_config = super().megatron_to_hf_config(provider)
+        pattern = (provider.hybrid_layer_pattern or "").split(Symbols.MTP_SEPARATOR)[0].replace(Symbols.PIPE, "")
+        num_hybrid_layers = provider.num_layers
+        if (
+            len(pattern) != num_hybrid_layers
+            or len(pattern) % 2
+            or set(pattern[0::2]) - {Symbols.ATTENTION}
+            or set(pattern[1::2]) - {Symbols.MLP, Symbols.MOE}
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"Beam exports need num_layers hybrid layers alternating attention '*' and MLP '-' / MoE 'E'; "
+                f"got hybrid_layer_pattern={provider.hybrid_layer_pattern!r} for num_layers={num_hybrid_layers}."
+            )
+        num_layers = num_hybrid_layers // 2
+        hf_config["num_hidden_layers"] = num_layers
+
+        # linear_qkv has no bias; gate_bias is its own parameter.
+        hf_config["attention_bias"] = False
+        if provider.window_size is not None:
+            hf_config["sliding_window"] = provider.window_size[0] + 1
+            skip = provider.window_attn_skip_freq
+            if skip is None:
+                sliding = [1] * num_layers  # window_size alone slides every layer
+            else:
+                # int form: every skip-th layer is full attention, like core's is_layer_window_attention
+                sliding = _as_layer_list(skip, num_hybrid_layers, int_rule=lambda i, k: (i + 1) % k != 0)[0::2]
+        else:
+            hf_config["sliding_window"] = None
+            sliding = [0] * num_layers
+        layer_types = ["sliding_attention" if s else "full_attention" for s in sliding]
+        hf_config["layer_types"] = layer_types
+
+        # rope_parameters keyed by layer type; None marks a NoPE (SSMax) layer type. Beam ties
+        # RoPE/NoPE to the layer type, so all layers of one type must agree.
+        no_rope = provider.no_rope_freq
+        if no_rope is None:
+            skips = [0] * num_layers
+        else:
+            skips = _as_layer_list(no_rope, num_hybrid_layers, int_rule=lambda i, k: (i + 1) % k == 0)[0::2]
+        rope_parameters: dict[str, dict | None] = {}
+        for layer_type in LAYER_TYPES:
+            flags = {skips[i] for i, t in enumerate(layer_types) if t == layer_type}
+            if not flags:
+                continue
+            if len(flags) > 1:
+                raise ValueError(
+                    f"Beam keys RoPE/NoPE by layer type, but the {layer_type} layers mix RoPE and NoPE "
+                    "(no_rope_freq disagrees within the type); this model is not representable as BeamConfig."
+                )
+            rope_parameters[layer_type] = (
+                None if flags.pop() else {"rope_type": "default", "rope_theta": float(provider.rotary_base)}
+            )
+        hf_config["rope_parameters"] = rope_parameters
+        # The generic CONFIG_MAPPING emits flat RoPE keys and expert-count aliases Beam does not
+        # declare; drop them so the exported config.json carries only the Beam schema.
+        for key in ("rope_theta", "partial_rotary_factor", "num_local_experts", "n_routed_experts"):
+            hf_config.pop(key, None)
+
+        mlp_symbols = pattern[1::2]
+        if Symbols.MOE in mlp_symbols:
+            hf_config["norm_topk_prob"] = not provider.moe_router_pre_softmax
+            hf_config["n_group"] = provider.moe_router_num_groups
+            hf_config["topk_group"] = provider.moe_router_group_topk
+            hf_config["routed_scaling_factor"] = provider.moe_router_topk_scaling_factor
+        else:
+            # BeamConfig requires typed MoE defaults even when no layer uses experts.
+            for key in _DENSE_EXPORT_DROPS:
+                hf_config.pop(key, None)
+        hf_config["mlp_layer_types"] = ["sparse" if symbol == Symbols.MOE else "dense" for symbol in mlp_symbols]
+
+        hf_config["final_logit_softcapping"] = provider.final_logit_softcapping
+        return hf_config
+
+    def provider_bridge(self, hf_pretrained):
+        """Build a compatibility provider from the same config mapping as the builder."""
+        warnings.warn(
+            "BeamBridge.provider_bridge() is a legacy compatibility API; prefer "
+            "AutoBridge.get_model_config() / AutoBridge.get_model() for new integrations.",
+            FutureWarning,
+            stacklevel=2,
+        )
+        return BeamModelProvider(**self.hf_config_to_model_config_kwargs(hf_pretrained.config))
+
+    def mapping_registry(self) -> MegatronMappingRegistry:
+        """Map every Beam layer onto its two hybrid layers.
+
+        Beam layer ``i`` (``model.layers.{i}``) is attention at ``decoder.layers.{2i}`` and a
+        dense MLP or MoE, per ``mlp_layer_types``, at ``decoder.layers.{2i+1}``.
+        """
+        if self.hf_config is None:
+            raise RuntimeError("BeamBridge.mapping_registry() needs hf_config to lay out the hybrid layers.")
+        mappings: list = [
+            AutoMapping(megatron_param="embedding.word_embeddings.weight", hf_param="model.embed_tokens.weight"),
+            AutoMapping(megatron_param="output_layer.weight", hf_param="lm_head.weight"),
+            AutoMapping(megatron_param="decoder.final_norm.weight", hf_param="model.norm.weight"),
+        ]
+        for i, is_moe in enumerate(_moe_layer_pattern(self.hf_config)):
+            hf = f"model.layers.{i}"
+            mappings += _attention_layer_mappings(f"decoder.layers.{2 * i}", hf)
+            mlp = f"decoder.layers.{2 * i + 1}"
+            mappings += _moe_layer_mappings(mlp, hf) if is_moe else _dense_mlp_layer_mappings(mlp, hf)
+        return MegatronMappingRegistry(*mappings)
+
+
+def _attention_layer_mappings(layer: str, hf: str) -> list:
+    """Parameters of one attention hybrid layer."""
+    direct = {
+        "self_attention.linear_qkv.layer_norm_weight": "input_layernorm.weight",
+        "self_attention.q_layernorm.weight": "self_attn.q_norm.weight",
+        "self_attention.k_layernorm.weight": "self_attn.k_norm.weight",
+        "self_attention.linear_proj.weight": "self_attn.o_proj.weight",
+        "self_attention.output_gate_bias.bias": "self_attn.gate_bias",
+        "post_self_attn_layernorm.weight": "post_attention_layernorm.weight",
+    }
+    return [
+        *(AutoMapping(megatron_param=f"{layer}.{m}", hf_param=f"{hf}.{h}") for m, h in direct.items()),
+        BeamQKVGateMapping(
+            megatron_param=f"{layer}.self_attention.linear_qkv.weight",
+            q=f"{hf}.self_attn.q_proj.weight",
+            k=f"{hf}.self_attn.k_proj.weight",
+            v=f"{hf}.self_attn.v_proj.weight",
+            g=f"{hf}.self_attn.gate_proj.weight",
+        ),
+    ]
+
+
+def _dense_mlp_layer_mappings(layer: str, hf: str) -> list:
+    """Parameters of one dense MLP hybrid layer (the pre-MLP norm is fused into ``linear_fc1``)."""
+    return [
+        AutoMapping(
+            megatron_param=f"{layer}.mlp.linear_fc1.layer_norm_weight",
+            hf_param=f"{hf}.pre_feedforward_layernorm.weight",
+        ),
+        GatedMLPMapping(
+            megatron_param=f"{layer}.mlp.linear_fc1.weight",
+            gate=f"{hf}.mlp.gate_proj.weight",
+            up=f"{hf}.mlp.up_proj.weight",
+        ),
+        AutoMapping(megatron_param=f"{layer}.mlp.linear_fc2.weight", hf_param=f"{hf}.mlp.down_proj.weight"),
+        AutoMapping(
+            megatron_param=f"{layer}.post_mlp_layernorm.weight", hf_param=f"{hf}.post_feedforward_layernorm.weight"
+        ),
+    ]
+
+
+def _moe_layer_mappings(layer: str, hf: str) -> list:
+    """Parameters of one MoE hybrid layer."""
+    direct = {
+        "pre_mlp_layernorm.weight": "pre_feedforward_layernorm.weight",
+        "mlp.router.weight": "mlp.gate.weight",
+        "mlp.router.expert_bias": "mlp.gate.e_score_correction_bias",
+        "mlp.experts.linear_fc2.weight*": "mlp.experts.*.down_proj.weight",
+        "post_mlp_layernorm.weight": "post_feedforward_layernorm.weight",
+    }
+    return [
+        *(AutoMapping(megatron_param=f"{layer}.{m}", hf_param=f"{hf}.{h}") for m, h in direct.items()),
+        GatedMLPMapping(
+            megatron_param=f"{layer}.mlp.experts.linear_fc1.weight*",
+            gate=f"{hf}.mlp.experts.*.gate_proj.weight",
+            up=f"{hf}.mlp.experts.*.up_proj.weight",
+        ),
+    ]

+"""Model builder for Beam: the Hybrid builder with the Beam stack spec and final-logit soft-capping."""
+
+from megatron.core.models.hybrid.hybrid_model import HybridModel
+from megatron.core.process_groups_config import ProcessGroupCollection
+
+from megatron.bridge.models.beam.beam_config import BeamModelConfig
+from megatron.bridge.models.beam.modeling_beam import BeamOutputLayer, beam_hybrid_stack_spec
+from megatron.bridge.models.gemma.modules import extend_instance
+from megatron.bridge.models.hybrid.hybrid_builder import HybridModelBuilder
+
+
+class BeamModelBuilder(HybridModelBuilder):
+    """Build ``HybridModel`` stages from the Beam stack spec; soft-cap the output layer on the last one."""
+
+    def __init__(self, model_config: BeamModelConfig) -> None:
+        if not isinstance(model_config, BeamModelConfig):
+            raise TypeError(f"Expected BeamModelConfig, got {type(model_config).__name__}.")
+        super().__init__(model_config)
+
+    def build_model(
+        self,
+        pg_collection: ProcessGroupCollection,
+        pre_process: bool | None = None,
+        post_process: bool | None = None,
+        vp_stage: int | None = None,
+    ) -> HybridModel:
+        """Build one stage; the stage that owns ``output_layer`` gets the soft cap."""
+        config = self._model_config
+        restore_spec = config.hybrid_stack_spec is None
+        if restore_spec:
+            config.hybrid_stack_spec = beam_hybrid_stack_spec(config.transformer)
+        try:
+            model = super().build_model(pg_collection, pre_process, post_process, vp_stage)
+        finally:
+            if restore_spec:
+                config.hybrid_stack_spec = None
+        if model.post_process and config.transformer.final_logit_softcapping:
+            extend_instance(model.output_layer, BeamOutputLayer)
+        return model

+"""Beam model configuration: a ``HybridModel`` config plus the Beam architecture fields."""
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Any, ClassVar, Optional
+
+from megatron.core.models.hybrid.hybrid_layer_allocation import Symbols
+
+from megatron.bridge.models.beam.modeling_beam import validate_beam_config
+from megatron.bridge.models.common import ModelConfigOverrideMixin, deserialize_model_config
+from megatron.bridge.models.hybrid.hybrid_builder import HybridModelConfig
+from megatron.bridge.models.transformer_config import TransformerConfig
+from megatron.bridge.utils.activation_map import callable_to_str, str_to_callable

+@dataclass
+class BeamTransformerConfig(TransformerConfig):
+    """Bridge ``TransformerConfig`` plus the Beam fields Megatron-Core does not declare.
+
+    The modules in :mod:`~megatron.bridge.models.beam.modeling_beam` read them.
+    """
+
+    attention_output_gate_bias: bool = False
+    """Gate the attention output with ``sigmoid(gate + bias[head])``; requires ``attention_output_gate``.
+    The bias lives in ``SelfAttention.output_gate_bias`` and is sharded across TP with the heads."""
+
+    post_self_attn_layernorm: bool = False
+    """Normalize the self-attention output before the residual add ("sandwich" norm)."""
+
+    post_mlp_layernorm: bool = False
+    """Normalize the MLP output before the residual add ("sandwich" norm)."""
+
+    depth_scaled_residual: bool = False
+    """Replace each residual add with ``out*(1/sqrt(idx)) + residual*sqrt((idx-1)/idx)``,
+    ``idx = layer_number + 1`` with the hybrid stack's 1-based ``layer_number``."""
+
+    ssmax: bool = False
+    """Scale queries on NoPE layers by ``(1 + (position + 1) / 2048) ** 0.1``; requires ``no_rope_freq``."""
+
+    moe_router_fp32_params: bool = False
+    """Keep router weights and biases in fp32, including through ``Float16Module``;
+    requires ``moe_router_dtype='fp32'``."""
+
+    final_logit_softcapping: Optional[float] = None
+    """``logits = cap * tanh(logits / cap)`` on the output layer; ``None`` or ``0`` disables it."""
+
+    def finalize(self) -> None:
+        """Run the deferred Megatron-Core post-init, then validate the Beam fields."""
+        super().finalize()
+        validate_beam_config(self)
+
+
+def beam_pipeline_layer_pattern(pattern: str, num_stages: int) -> str:
+    """Split a Beam hybrid pattern into ``num_stages`` ``|``-separated segments.
+
+    Beam layer ``i`` is the hybrid pair ``pattern[2i:2i+2]`` (attention, then MLP/MoE); pairs
+    stay on one stage and earlier stages take the remainder. Existing separators are dropped,
+    so a pattern saved under another pipeline size is re-split.
+    """
+    flat = pattern.replace(Symbols.PIPE, "")
+    if len(flat) % 2:
+        raise ValueError(f"Beam hybrid patterns pair every attention layer with an MLP layer, got {pattern!r}.")
+    if num_stages <= 1:
+        return flat
+    blocks = [flat[i : i + 2] for i in range(0, len(flat), 2)]
+    if len(blocks) < num_stages:
+        raise ValueError(f"{len(blocks)} Beam layers cannot fill {num_stages} pipeline stages.")
+    base, extra = divmod(len(blocks), num_stages)
+    segments, offset = [], 0
+    for stage in range(num_stages):
+        count = base + int(stage < extra)
+        segments.append("".join(blocks[offset : offset + count]))
+        offset += count
+    return Symbols.PIPE.join(segments)
+
+
+@dataclass(kw_only=True)
+class BeamModelConfig(ModelConfigOverrideMixin, HybridModelConfig):
+    """``HybridModel`` config whose builder uses the Beam stack spec and soft-caps the output layer.
+
+    ``hybrid_layer_pattern`` holds two hybrid layers per Beam layer: ``*`` attention followed
+    by ``-`` (dense MLP) or ``E`` (MoE), so ``transformer.num_layers`` and the per-layer lists
+    (``no_rope_freq``, ``window_attn_skip_freq``) count hybrid layers. ``_builder_`` names
+    :class:`~.beam_builder.BeamModelBuilder`.
+    """
+
+    builder: ClassVar[str] = "megatron.bridge.models.beam.BeamModelBuilder"
+    transformer_config_class: ClassVar[type[TransformerConfig]] = BeamTransformerConfig
+
+    def finalize(self) -> None:
+        """Split the pattern at Beam-layer boundaries for pipeline parallelism, then validate."""
+        transformer = self.transformer
+        num_stages = (transformer.pipeline_model_parallel_size or 1) * (
+            transformer.virtual_pipeline_model_parallel_size or 1
+        )
+        if (
+            self.hybrid_layer_pattern
+            and transformer.num_layers_in_first_pipeline_stage is None
+            and transformer.num_layers_in_last_pipeline_stage is None
+        ):
+            self.hybrid_layer_pattern = beam_pipeline_layer_pattern(self.hybrid_layer_pattern, num_stages)
+        super().finalize()
+
+    def get_builder_cls(self) -> type:
+        """Resolve the Beam builder through Bridge's target allowlist."""
+        builder_cls = _resolve_target(self.builder, full_key="_builder_")
+        if not isinstance(builder_cls, type):
+            raise TypeError(f"Builder target '{self.builder}' did not resolve to a class.")
+        return builder_cls
+
+    def as_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        """Serialize the config with a symbolic activation function."""
+        data = super().as_dict()
+        transformer_data = data.get("transformer")
+        if not isinstance(transformer_data, dict):
+            raise TypeError("Serialized Beam config must contain a transformer mapping.")
+        activation_func = self.transformer.activation_func
+        if isinstance(activation_func, str):
+            str_to_callable(activation_func)
+            activation_name = activation_func
+        else:
+            activation_name = callable_to_str(activation_func)
+        if activation_name is None:
+            raise ValueError(f"Cannot serialize unregistered activation callable: {activation_func!r}.")
+        transformer_data["activation_func"] = activation_name
+        return data
+
+    @classmethod
+    def from_dict(cls, data: dict[str, Any]) -> "BeamModelConfig":
+        """Deserialize a Beam config and restore its activation callable."""
+        restored_data = dict(data)
+        transformer_data = restored_data.get("transformer")
+        if isinstance(transformer_data, dict):
+            restored_transformer = dict(transformer_data)
+            activation_name = restored_transformer.get("activation_func")
+            if isinstance(activation_name, str):
+                restored_transformer["activation_func"] = str_to_callable(activation_name)
+            restored_data["transformer"] = restored_transformer
+        result = deserialize_model_config(restored_data)
+        if not isinstance(result, cls):
+            raise TypeError(f"Expected {cls.__name__}, got {type(result).__name__}.")
+        return result

+"""Beam full-width attention-gate packing.
+
+Each query group contains ``[Q, gate, K, V]``. Q and gate each have
+``heads_per_group * head_dim`` rows; K and V each have ``head_dim`` rows.
+TP/PP communication uses the inherited AutoMapping delegate.
+"""
+
+from typing import Tuple
+
+import torch
+
+from megatron.bridge.models.conversion.param_mapping import QKVGMapping
+from megatron.bridge.models.conversion.utils import remove_non_pickleables
+
+
+def _geometry(config) -> Tuple[int, int, int, int]:
+    """Return ``(head_num, num_query_groups, heads_per_group, head_size)``."""
+    head_num = config.num_attention_heads
+    num_query_groups = config.num_query_groups or head_num
+    heads_per_group = head_num // num_query_groups
+    head_size = config.kv_channels or (config.hidden_size // head_num)
+    return head_num, num_query_groups, heads_per_group, head_size
+
+
+def merge_qkv_gate_weights(config, q, k, v, g) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Interleave Q, K, V and a full-width gate into Megatron's ``linear_qkv``."""
+    head_num, num_query_groups, heads_per_group, head_size = _geometry(config)
+    hidden_size = q.shape[-1]
+
+    if g.shape[0] != head_num * head_size:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"Beam gate_proj should emit num_heads*head_dim={head_num * head_size} rows, got {tuple(g.shape)}."
+        )
+
+    width = heads_per_group * head_size
+    blocks = [
+        weight.reshape(num_query_groups, rows, hidden_size)
+        for weight, rows in zip((q, g, k, v), (width, width, head_size, head_size))
+    ]
+    return torch.cat(blocks, dim=1).reshape(-1, hidden_size)
+
+
+def split_qkv_gate_weights(config, qkv: torch.Tensor):
+    """Inverse of :func:`merge_qkv_gate_weights`; returns ``(q, k, v, g)``."""
+    _, groups, heads_per_group, head_size = _geometry(config)
+    width = heads_per_group * head_size
+    rows = qkv.reshape(groups, -1, qkv.shape[-1])
+    q, g, k, v = torch.split(rows, [width, width, head_size, head_size], dim=1)
+    return tuple(weight.reshape(-1, qkv.shape[-1]) for weight in (q, k, v, g))
+
+
+class BeamQKVGateMapping(QKVGMapping):
+    """Fuse Q/K/V and a full-width attention gate for Beam."""
+
+    def hf_to_megatron(self, hf_weights: dict[str, torch.Tensor], megatron_module: torch.nn.Module) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """Pack the full-width gate with Q/K/V and distribute the fused weight."""
+        merged = None
+        if self.tp_rank == 0:
+            if hf_weights["q"].ndim == 1:
+                raise NotImplementedError("BeamQKVGateMapping handles weights only.")
+            config = self._get_config(megatron_module)
+            merged = merge_qkv_gate_weights(config, hf_weights["q"], hf_weights["k"], hf_weights["v"], hf_weights["g"])
+        return self._tp_mapping.hf_to_megatron(merged, megatron_module)
+
+    def megatron_to_hf(
+        self, megatron_weights: torch.Tensor | None, megatron_module: torch.nn.Module | None
+    ) -> dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
+        """Gather the fused weight and split Beam's four attention projections."""
+        if megatron_weights is not None:
+            megatron_weights = self.maybe_dequantize(megatron_weights)
+
+        config = None
+        if megatron_module is not None:
+            config = remove_non_pickleables(self._get_config(megatron_module), max_depth=3)
+        config = self.broadcast_obj_from_pp_rank(config, "beam_qkvg_config")
+
+        packed_dict = self._tp_mapping.megatron_to_hf(megatron_weights, megatron_module)
+        if not packed_dict:
+            return {}
+        packed = next(iter(packed_dict.values()))
+        if packed.ndim == 1:
+            raise NotImplementedError("BeamQKVGateMapping handles weights only.")
+        q, k, v, g = split_qkv_gate_weights(config, packed)
+        return {
+            self.hf_param["q"]: q,
+            self.hf_param["k"]: k,
+            self.hf_param["v"]: v,
+            self.hf_param["g"]: g,
+        }

+:func:`beam_hybrid_stack_spec`, which builds the hybrid layers from Megatron-Core's

+no hook for one piece: the distributed optimizer's parameter-group index map, which
+assumes a group holds a single parameter dtype.
+:func:`patch_distributed_optimizer_group_index_map` monkey patches it once the first
+fp32 Beam router is built.

+def beam_logit_softcapping(logits: torch.Tensor, cap: Optional[float]) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """``cap * tanh(logits / cap)`` computed and returned in fp32, exactly as ``BeamForCausalLM`` does.
+
+    ``None`` / ``0`` disables the cap and returns ``logits`` unchanged (in their own dtype).
+    """
+    if not cap:
+        return logits
+    return torch.tanh(logits.float() / cap) * cap

+    def forward(self, *args, **kwargs):
+        """Project, then soft-cap in fp32."""
+        output, bias = super().forward(*args, **kwargs)
+        return beam_logit_softcapping(output, self.config.final_logit_softcapping), bias
+

+BEAM_FEATURE_FIELDS = (
+    "attention_output_gate_bias",
+    "post_self_attn_layernorm",
+    "post_mlp_layernorm",
+    "depth_scaled_residual",
+    "ssmax",
+    "moe_router_fp32_params",

+def validate_beam_config(config) -> None:
+    """Reject Beam features on code paths that would silently skip them.
+
+    SSMax runs in core attention, sandwich norms and depth-scaled residuals replace the
+    layer's bias-dropout-add; paths that bypass either would build a different model.
+    """
+    if config.attention_output_gate_bias and not config.attention_output_gate:
+        raise ValueError("attention_output_gate_bias requires attention_output_gate=True.")
+
+    if config.moe_router_fp32_params and config.moe_router_dtype != "fp32":
+        raise ValueError(
+            "moe_router_fp32_params requires moe_router_dtype='fp32': fp32 router parameters "
+            "are only meaningful when the routing GEMM itself runs in fp32."
+        )
+
+    if config.ssmax:
+        if not config.no_rope_freq:
+            raise ValueError("ssmax requires no_rope_freq: scaling only applies to NoPE layers.")
+        if config.flash_decode:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "ssmax cannot be used with flash_decode: flash decoding bypasses core attention, "
+                "where SSMax is applied."
+            )
+        if config.multi_latent_attention:
+            raise ValueError("ssmax is not implemented for multi_latent_attention.")
+        if config.experimental_attention_variant is not None:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"ssmax is not implemented for experimental_attention_variant {config.experimental_attention_variant!r}."
+            )
+
+    if config.post_self_attn_layernorm or config.post_mlp_layernorm or config.depth_scaled_residual:
+        what = "post_self_attn_layernorm / post_mlp_layernorm / depth_scaled_residual"
+        if config.inference_fuse_tp_communication:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"{what} cannot be used with inference_fuse_tp_communication: that path adds the "
+                "residual inside linear_proj/linear_fc2, so it would be added twice."
+            )
+        if config.transformer_impl == "inference_optimized":
+            raise ValueError(f"{what} are not supported by transformer_impl='inference_optimized'.")
+        if config.enable_mhc_connections:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"{what} are not supported with enable_mhc_connections (HyperConnection layers use "
+                "their own residual kernel)."
+            )
+        if config.overlap_moe_expert_parallel_comm:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"{what} are not supported with overlap_moe_expert_parallel_comm: the fine-grained "
+                "MoE schedule runs the MLP residual outside TransformerLayer."
+            )
+        if config.depth_scaled_residual and config.mtp_num_layers:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "depth_scaled_residual is not supported with mtp_num_layers: MTP layers restart "
+                "layer_number at 1, so the depth index would be wrong."
+            )
+

+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# SSMax (scalable softmax) on NoPE layers
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+def ssmax_absolute_positions(
+    local_seq_len: int, position_offset: int = 0, cp_rank: int = 0, cp_size: int = 1, device=None
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Absolute sequence positions for the tokens this rank actually holds.
+
+    Without CP, positions are contiguous. Otherwise, ``get_batch_on_this_cp_rank``
+    splits the sequence into ``2 * cp_size`` chunks and gives rank ``r`` chunks
+    ``(r, 2 * cp_size - r - 1)``. For CP=2 with 16 tokens::
+
+        rank 0 local -> [0 1 2 3][12 13 14 15]
+        rank 1 local -> [4 5 6 7][ 8  9 10 11]
+    """
+    if cp_size == 1:
+        return torch.arange(position_offset, position_offset + local_seq_len, device=device, dtype=torch.float32)
+
+    if local_seq_len % 2 != 0:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"Context parallelism gives each rank two chunks, so the local sequence length "
+            f"must be even; got {local_seq_len}."
+        )
+    chunk = local_seq_len // 2
+    first_start = cp_rank * chunk
+    second_start = (2 * cp_size - 1 - cp_rank) * chunk
+    first = torch.arange(first_start, first_start + chunk, device=device, dtype=torch.float32)
+    second = torch.arange(second_start, second_start + chunk, device=device, dtype=torch.float32)
+    return torch.cat([first, second]) + position_offset
+
+
+def ssmax_packed_positions(
+    cu_seqlens: torch.Tensor,
+    position_offset: int = 0,
+    cp_rank: int = 0,
+    cp_size: int = 1,
+    total_tokens: int | None = None,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Within-sequence positions for every token of a packed (``thd``) buffer.
+
+    As in RoPE's ``thd`` path, use global cumulative lengths (the padded variant
+    for padded batches). Apply :func:`ssmax_absolute_positions`' zigzag layout
+    independently to each sequence under CP.
+
+    Fully vectorised; passing ``total_tokens`` (the local buffer length) avoids a
+    host sync. Tokens past the last real token (tail padding) are clamped onto the
+    final sequence; they are masked out of attention anyway.
+    """
+    cu = cu_seqlens.to(torch.int64)
+    global_lens = cu[1:] - cu[:-1]
+    local_lens = global_lens // cp_size if cp_size > 1 else global_lens
+    local_cu = torch.zeros_like(cu)
+    local_cu[1:] = torch.cumsum(local_lens, dim=0)
+    if total_tokens is None:
+        total_tokens = int(local_cu[-1].item())
+    token = torch.arange(total_tokens, device=cu.device, dtype=torch.int64)
+    seq_idx = (torch.searchsorted(local_cu, token, right=True) - 1).clamp(min=0, max=cu.numel() - 2)
+    local_pos = token - local_cu[seq_idx]
+    if cp_size > 1:
+        seg = local_lens[seq_idx] // 2  # each rank holds two chunks of this size per sequence
+        second = local_pos >= seg
+        pos = torch.where(second, (2 * cp_size - 1 - cp_rank) * seg + (local_pos - seg), cp_rank * seg + local_pos)
+    else:
+        pos = local_pos
+    return pos.to(torch.float32) + position_offset
+
+
+def apply_ssmax_to_query(
+    query: torch.Tensor,
+    position_offset: int = 0,
+    cp_rank: int = 0,
+    cp_size: int = 1,
+    cu_seqlens: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Scale ``query`` by ``(1 + (position + 1) / 2048) ** 0.1`` for each of its positions.
+
+    Args:
+        query: ``[sq, b, np, hn]`` normally, ``[t, np, hn]`` for packed ``thd`` batches.
+        position_offset: Absolute position of ``query[0]`` (non-zero during incremental decoding).
+        cp_rank: This rank's index within the context-parallel group.
+        cp_size: Context-parallel world size; see :func:`ssmax_absolute_positions`.
+        cu_seqlens: Global cumulative sequence lengths of a packed batch; when given,
+            positions restart at every sequence (see :func:`ssmax_packed_positions`).
+
+    Returns:
+        The scaled query, same shape and dtype as the input.
+    """
+    seq_len = query.shape[0]
+    if cu_seqlens is None:
+        positions = ssmax_absolute_positions(seq_len, position_offset, cp_rank, cp_size, device=query.device)
+    else:
+        positions = ssmax_packed_positions(cu_seqlens, position_offset, cp_rank, cp_size, total_tokens=seq_len)
+    # Multiply in fp32 before rounding once: a bf16 scale rounds to 1 near the sequence start.
+    scale = torch.exp(0.1 * torch.log1p((positions + 1) / 2048))
+    scale = scale.view(seq_len, *([1] * (query.dim() - 1)))
+    return (query.float() * scale).to(query.dtype)
+
+
+def _is_ssmax_layer(config, layer_number: int) -> bool:
+    """SSMax applies to the NoPE layers (``no_rope_freq`` is 0-indexed, ``layer_number`` 1-indexed)."""
+    return bool(config.ssmax and config.no_rope_freq and config.no_rope_freq[layer_number - 1])
+
+
+class _BeamSSMaxCoreAttentionMixin:
+    """Core attention that applies SSMax to the query of NoPE layers.
+
+    ``Attention`` calls core attention right after RoPE, on both the plain and the
+    activation-checkpointed path, so scaling here is equivalent to scaling in
+    ``Attention.forward``. Paths that bypass core attention (flash decoding, dynamic
+    batching) are rejected by :func:`validate_beam_config` and :class:`BeamSelfAttention`.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
+        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
+        config = kwargs.get("config", args[0] if args else None)
+        layer_number = kwargs.get("layer_number", args[1] if len(args) > 1 else 1)
+        self._beam_ssmax = _is_ssmax_layer(config, layer_number)
+        pg_collection = kwargs.get("pg_collection")
+        if pg_collection is not None and hasattr(pg_collection, "cp"):
+            self._beam_cp_group = pg_collection.cp
+        else:
+            self._beam_cp_group = parallel_state.get_context_parallel_group(check_initialized=False)
+
+    def forward(self, query, key, value, attention_mask, *args, **kwargs):
+        """Scale the query on NoPE layers, then run the wrapped core attention."""
+        if self._beam_ssmax:
+            query = self._beam_apply_ssmax(
+                query, key, kwargs.get("packed_seq_params", args[2] if len(args) > 2 else None)
+            )
+        return super().forward(query, key, value, attention_mask, *args, **kwargs)
+
+    def _beam_apply_ssmax(self, query, key, packed_seq_params):
+        cp_group = self._beam_cp_group
+        cp_size = cp_group.size() if cp_group is not None else 1
+        cp_rank = cp_group.rank() if cp_size > 1 else 0
+        cu_seqlens = None
+        if packed_seq_params is not None:
+            if packed_seq_params.qkv_format != "thd":
+                raise NotImplementedError(
+                    "SSMax with packed sequences is implemented for the 'thd' format only, "
+                    f"got qkv_format={packed_seq_params.qkv_format!r}."
+                )
+            cu_seqlens = (
+                packed_seq_params.cu_seqlens_q_padded
+                if packed_seq_params.cu_seqlens_q_padded is not None
+                else packed_seq_params.cu_seqlens_q
+            )
+        position_offset = 0
+        if key.shape[0] != query.shape[0]:
+            # Static-batching decode: the key holds the cached prefix, the query only new tokens.
+            if cu_seqlens is not None:
+                raise NotImplementedError("SSMax with packed sequences is implemented for the training forward only.")
+            if cp_size > 1:
+                raise NotImplementedError(
+                    "SSMax with context parallelism is only implemented for the full-sequence forward, "
+                    "not incremental decoding."
+                )
+            position_offset = key.shape[0] - query.shape[0]
+        return apply_ssmax_to_query(query, position_offset, cp_rank=cp_rank, cp_size=cp_size, cu_seqlens=cu_seqlens)
+
+
+class BeamTEDotProductAttention(_BeamSSMaxCoreAttentionMixin, TEDotProductAttention):
+    """Transformer Engine ``TEDotProductAttention`` with SSMax on NoPE layers."""

+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Attention output gate with a per-head bias
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+def apply_output_gate(x: torch.Tensor, gate: torch.Tensor, bias: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Gate ``x`` with ``sigmoid(gate [+ bias per head])``.
+
+    The sigmoid (and the bias add) run in fp32; the result is cast back to ``x.dtype``.
+
+    Args:
+        x: attention output, ``[..., num_heads * head_dim]`` with heads major.
+        gate: gate pre-activations with as many elements as ``x``.
+        bias: optional ``[num_heads]`` bias, one scalar per (local) head.
+    """
+    x_dtype = x.dtype
+    gate = gate.contiguous().view(*x.shape)
+    if bias is None:
+        return (x * torch.sigmoid(gate.float())).to(x_dtype)
+
+    num_heads = bias.numel()
+    if x.shape[-1] % num_heads != 0:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"Gate bias has {num_heads} heads but the attention output width {x.shape[-1]} is not divisible by it."
+        )
+    gate = gate.view(*x.shape[:-1], num_heads, -1).float()
+    gate = gate + bias.float().view(*([1] * (x.dim() - 1)), num_heads, 1)
+    return (x * torch.sigmoid(gate).view(*x.shape)).to(x_dtype)
+
+
+class AttentionOutputGateBias(MegatronModule):
+    """Zero-initialized, TP-sharded per-head bias for the attention output gate.
+
+    A dedicated module owns the bias so checkpoint converters can identify it by class name.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self, config, num_heads_per_partition: int, tp_group: Optional[torch.distributed.ProcessGroup] = None
+    ):
+        super().__init__(config=config)
+        self.tp_group = tp_group
+        if config.use_cpu_initialization or not torch.cuda.is_available():
+            device = torch.device("cpu")
+        else:
+            device = torch.cuda.current_device()
+        self.bias = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.empty(num_heads_per_partition, dtype=config.params_dtype, device=device))
+        if config.perform_initialization:
+            self.reset_parameters()
+        set_tensor_model_parallel_attributes(self.bias, is_parallel=True, dim=0, stride=1)
+
+    def reset_parameters(self) -> None:
+        """Initialize the bias to zero."""
+        torch.nn.init.zeros_(self.bias)
+
+    def sharded_state_dict(
+        self,
+        prefix: str = "",
+        sharded_offsets: Tuple[Tuple[int, int, int], ...] = (),
+        metadata: Optional[dict] = None,
+    ):
+        """Shard ``bias`` along dim 0 across tensor-parallel ranks."""
+        state_dict = self.state_dict(prefix="", keep_vars=True)
+        metadata = ensure_metadata_has_dp_cp_group(metadata)
+        return make_sharded_tensors_for_checkpoint(
+            state_dict,
+            prefix,
+            {"bias": 0},
+            sharded_offsets,
+            tp_group=get_tensor_model_parallel_group_if_none(self.tp_group),
+            dp_cp_group=metadata["dp_cp_group"],
+        )
+
+
+class BeamSelfAttention(SelfAttention):
+    """``SelfAttention`` whose output gate carries a per-head bias.
+
+    The bias follows the local query heads, including under KV replication (TP > KV heads).
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, config, *args, **kwargs):
+        super().__init__(config, *args, **kwargs)
+        self.output_gate_bias = None
+        if config.attention_output_gate and config.attention_output_gate_bias:
+            self.output_gate_bias = AttentionOutputGateBias(
+                config,
+                divide(config.num_attention_heads, self.world_size),
+                tp_group=self.pg_collection.tp,
+            )
+
+    @jit_fuser
+    def _apply_output_gate(self, x, gate):
+        # Fused like Megatron-Core's Attention._apply_output_gate, so the gate rounds identically.
+        bias = self.output_gate_bias.bias if self.output_gate_bias is not None else None
+        return apply_output_gate(x, gate, bias)
+
+    def forward_pre_attn_and_core_attn(self, *args, **kwargs):
+        """Reject dynamic-batching inference on SSMax layers: it bypasses core attention."""
+        if _is_ssmax_layer(self.config, self.layer_number):
+            inference_context = kwargs.get("inference_context")
+            if inference_context is None:
+                inference_context = kwargs.get("inference_params")
+            if inference_context is None and len(args) > 3:
+                inference_context = args[3]
+            if inference_context is not None and not inference_context.is_static_batching():
+                raise NotImplementedError("SSMax is not implemented for dynamic-batching inference.")
+        return super().forward_pre_attn_and_core_attn(*args, **kwargs)
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Sandwich norms and depth-scaled residuals
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+def depth_scaled_residual_coefs(layer_number: int) -> Tuple[float, float]:
+    """``(sublayer_scale, residual_scale)`` for the residual add of one hybrid layer; the squares sum to one.
+
+    ``residual_add_idx = layer_number + 1`` with ``HybridStack``'s 1-based ``layer_number``,
+    which counts attention and MLP layers separately: the embedding is the first term of the
+    residual stream, so Beam layer ``i`` (0-based) adds at ``2i + 2`` (attention) and
+    ``2i + 3`` (MLP).
+    """
+    residual_add_idx = layer_number + 1
+    return 1.0 / math.sqrt(residual_add_idx), math.sqrt((residual_add_idx - 1) / residual_add_idx)
+
+
+def scaled_residual_add(output: torch.Tensor, residual: torch.Tensor, coefs: Tuple[float, float]) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """``output * coefs[0] + residual * coefs[1]``, in the residual's dtype.
+
+    Scalar coefficients avoid saving the residual for backward, allowing activation
+    offload to release its storage after the add.
+    """
+    sublayer_scale, residual_scale = coefs
+    return torch.add(residual * residual_scale, output.to(residual.dtype), alpha=sublayer_scale)
+
+
+@dataclasses.dataclass
+class BeamTransformerLayerSubmodules(TransformerLayerSubmodules):
+    """``TransformerLayerSubmodules`` plus the two sandwich norms."""
+
+    post_self_attn_layernorm: type = IdentityOp
+    post_mlp_layernorm: type = IdentityOp
+
+
+class BeamTransformerLayerMixin:
+    """Sandwich norms and depth-scaled residual adds for an attention-only or MLP-only hybrid layer.
+
+    The bias-dropout-add of the sublayer the layer owns is replaced by :meth:`_beam_bda`,
+    which computes ``bias -> post norm -> dropout -> (depth-scaled) residual add``. The
+    absent sublayer keeps its identity pass-through. Everything else of the base layer
+    (offload commits, recompute hooks, viewless outputs) stays in place.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, config, submodules, layer_number: int = 1, *args, **kwargs):
+        super().__init__(config, submodules, layer_number, *args, **kwargs)
+        has_attention = not isinstance(self.self_attention, IdentityOp)
+        has_mlp = not isinstance(self.mlp, IdentityOp)
+        dsr = config.depth_scaled_residual
+        if (config.post_self_attn_layernorm or config.post_mlp_layernorm or dsr) and not isinstance(
+            self.cross_attention, IdentityOp
+        ):
+            raise NotImplementedError(
+                "post_self_attn_layernorm / post_mlp_layernorm / depth_scaled_residual are implemented for "
+                "decoder-only layers; cross-attention adds a residual that the depth index and post-norms "
+                "do not account for."
+            )
+        if dsr and has_attention and has_mlp:
+            raise NotImplementedError(
+                "depth_scaled_residual expects split hybrid layers (attention '*' and MLP '-'/'E' as separate "
+                "layers); a layer holding both would need two residual indices."
+            )
+
+        self.post_self_attn_layernorm = (
+            self._beam_build_post_norm(getattr(submodules, "post_self_attn_layernorm", IdentityOp))
+            if has_attention and config.post_self_attn_layernorm
+            else None
+        )
+        self.post_mlp_layernorm = (
+            self._beam_build_post_norm(getattr(submodules, "post_mlp_layernorm", IdentityOp))
+            if has_mlp and config.post_mlp_layernorm
+            else None
+        )
+        self._dsr_coefs = depth_scaled_residual_coefs(self.layer_number) if dsr else None
+
+        # The spec's bias-dropout-add may be a function or a module (IdentityFuncOp); drop a
+        # registered module before replacing it with a plain callable.
+        if has_attention and (self.post_self_attn_layernorm is not None or dsr):
+            self._modules.pop("self_attn_bda", None)
+            self.self_attn_bda = functools.partial(self._beam_bda, is_attention=True)
+        if has_mlp and (self.post_mlp_layernorm is not None or dsr):
+            self._modules.pop("mlp_bda", None)
+            self.mlp_bda = functools.partial(self._beam_bda, is_attention=False)
+
+    def _beam_build_post_norm(self, norm):
+        if norm is IdentityOp:
+            raise ValueError("Enabled post-layer norms require a normalization module in the spec.")
+        return norm(config=self.config, hidden_size=self.config.hidden_size, eps=self.config.layernorm_epsilon)
+
+    def _beam_bda(self, training: bool, fused: bool, *, is_attention: bool):
+        """Same call contract as ``get_bias_dropout_add``: returns ``f(x_with_bias, residual, prob)``."""
+        norm = self.post_self_attn_layernorm if is_attention else self.post_mlp_layernorm
+        coefs = self._dsr_coefs
+
+        def _sandwich_residual_add(output_with_bias, residual, prob):
+            # Order is bias -> norm -> dropout -> add. Normalizing after dropout would undo
+            # its 1/(1-p) rescale.
+            output, bias = output_with_bias
+            if bias is not None:
+                output = output + bias
+            if norm is not None:
+                output = norm(output)
+            if training and prob > 0.0:
+                output = torch.nn.functional.dropout(output, p=prob)
+            if coefs is not None:
+                return scaled_residual_add(output, residual, coefs)
+            return residual + output.to(residual.dtype)
+
+        return _sandwich_residual_add
+
+
+class BeamTransformerLayer(BeamTransformerLayerMixin, TransformerLayer):
+    """Attention-only hybrid layer (``*``) with Beam's sandwich norm and depth-scaled residual."""

+class BeamMLPLayer(BeamTransformerLayerMixin, MLPLayer):
+    """Dense MLP hybrid layer (``-``) with Beam's sandwich norm and depth-scaled residual."""

+class BeamMoETransformerLayer(BeamTransformerLayerMixin, MoETransformerLayer):
+    """MoE hybrid layer (``E``) with Beam's sandwich norm and depth-scaled residual."""
